integrity: Full finite enumeration and recorded output are included; claims apply only to proper labeled two-colorings. No independent review or external certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact metric for the point-line plane only. It does not prove a new abstract cubic graph classification or cover general projective planes. The published cubic graph F468 shares order and diameter with the recoloring graph, and a coordinate-preserving equivalent prior enumeration remains an originality risk.
title: Two-coloring flips in \(\operatorname{PG}(2,3)\): a sharp two-move Hamming detour
